commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.

90+7' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a low shot from long range towards the middle of the net, but David Soria makes a comfortable save to stop the effort.
90+7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Oviedo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+5' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
90+2' The game has begun to heat up. Alex Sancris (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Having seen unsporting behavior, Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Sebastian Boselli (Getafe) is the recipient.
90' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
88' The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
86' Here is a change. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
86' What a big chance! Alex Sancris (Getafe) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nacho Vidal departs the field of play to be replaced by Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thiago Borbas (Real Oviedo) replaces Ilyas Chaira.
84' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves decides to make a substitution. Federico Vinas will be replaced by Alex Fores (Real Oviedo).

84' Martin Satriano (Getafe) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
81' The free kick from long range, taken by Oviedo, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
78' Referee Cesar Soto Grado seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo).
77' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo)! Let's see what he decides.
76' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
74' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

74' Alex Sancris (Getafe) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Aaron Escandell pulls off a great save to deny his attempt towards the right side of the goal.
73' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to David Costas (Real Oviedo) for his blatant foul. Getafe are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
73' Here's the change. Abdel Abqar leaves the pitch and Alex Sancris (Getafe) comes on as a substitute.
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Oviedo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Abdel Abqar (Getafe) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. A mid-range free kick is awarded to Oviedo out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
67' The total number of attempts is 4:10.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Javier Munoz (Getafe) is coming onto the pitch as Davinchi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
64' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) replacing Thiago Fernandez.
63' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
59' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but David Soria is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
57' Haissem Hassan goes off the pitch and Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) comes on.

57' Luis Vazquez (Getafe) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
57' The attendance for today's match is 19135.
54' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) has to leave the pitch!

53' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
52' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
49' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives a chance to Luis Vazquez and Mario Martin (Getafe) is off.
46' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
41' The Oviedo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.
36' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
35' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Zaid Romero (Getafe) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
32' The referee points to the corner flag and Getafe will take a corner.
31' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' Davinchi (Getafe) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
23' Great teamplay by Getafe as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
18' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Getafe have a free kick.
17' Oviedo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
14' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.

12' It looks like Eric Bailly may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves replaces him with David Costas (Real Oviedo).
11' Looks like Eric Bailly (Real Oviedo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
9' Oviedo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
9' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) gathers a cross inside the box and strikes the ball. He wastes a great scoring opportunity as his shot only hits the right-hand post.
7' Davinchi (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Soto Grado no option but to blow his whistle.
5' The Oviedo players are exchanging some short passes.
3' Martin Satriano (Getafe) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.

Getafe will kick the game off.
